name: Alma
description: Alma is an AI nutrition coach that tracks what you eat, monitors 25+ micronutrients per meal, and scores your diet quality in real time using Harvard's Alternate Healthy Eating Index. Connect Alma to Claude and your full nutrition context comes with you: meals logged, nutrient gaps, Alma Score trends, and coaching history. Ask Claude questions about your actual diet, get personalized guidance, and close nutritional gaps faster. Built for anyone serious about eating better, from everyday health optimizers to GLP-1 patients and performance athletes.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Alma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Alma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.alma.food/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Alma MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Alma provides these MCP tools: get_user_profile, get_meal_data, get_alma_score_data, get_goals, and get_weight_history.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Alma?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Alma in health on the Manufact MCP catalog include CMS Coverage, NPI Registry, AllTrails MCP Server, ICD-10 Codes, and PopHIVE.
Alma requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Alma is developed by Alma. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
